headline: Turn compliance evidence into action before the next escalation
capabilities: Scan all executed trades for reporting accuracy, required fields, and best‑execution performance
Automate corrections and submissions to the regulatory portal
Identify upcoming certification expirations and enroll traders
outcomes: Ensured near‑perfect reporting accuracy and reduced exposure to regulatory penalties
Reduced compliance workload by automating reviews and reporting
Maintained certification readiness across the desk with automated scheduling and alerts
why_try: This demo makes regulated-workflow AI concrete: ask a plain-language question and surface the exact trade, trader, algorithm, field, evidence source, and approval step requiring attention.

sample_prompts.label: See what threatens audit readiness
sample_prompts.prompt: Are we going to fail our next MiFID audit? What's actually broken on the desk right now?

sample_prompts.label: Find who cannot trade today
sample_prompts.prompt: Which of my traders can't legally trade today, and who do I have to call?

sample_prompts.label: Identify reports likely to be rejected
sample_prompts.prompt: We executed a few hundred trades this week. Which ones will the regulator reject, and why exactly?

sample_prompts.label: Block an unsafe algorithm go-live
sample_prompts.prompt: Is anything about to go live that shouldn't?

sample_prompts.label: Prepare board-ready reporting evidence
sample_prompts.prompt: My head of trading says the reporting is fine. Prove him wrong with specifics I can take to the board.

business_flow: Chief compliance officers, compliance managers, and trading-desk supervisors
